LanguageData.DeadWorld_ZombieInfection.label: zombie infection
LanguageData.DeadWorld_ZombieInfection.description: A zombie infection that starts in one wounded body part and spreads slowly. If it reaches the head or torso, it becomes systemic throughout the body. After the configured incubation period, the infected pawn dies and reanimates. If killed by another cause first, it reanimates immediately.
LanguageData.DeadWorld_ZombieInfection.stages.0.label: localized
LanguageData.DeadWorld_ZombieInfection.stages.1.label: spreading
LanguageData.DeadWorld_ZombieInfection.stages.2.label: advanced
LanguageData.DeadWorld_ZombieInfectionSystemic.label: systemic zombie infection
LanguageData.DeadWorld_ZombieInfectionSystemic.descri: The infection has reached the head or torso and is now systemic throughout the body. It cannot be cured. If the pawn dies first, it reanimates immediately.
LanguageData.DeadWorld_ZombieResurrection.label: undead persistence
LanguageData.DeadWorld_ZombieResurrection.description: This zombie will rise again after its body recovers.
LanguageData.DeadWorld_ZombieRot.label: rotting
LanguageData.DeadWorld_ZombieRot.description: The corpse's skin has taken on the gray-green cast of decay.
LanguageData.DeadWorld_ZombieRotPale.label: rotting
LanguageData.DeadWorld_ZombieRotPale.description: The corpse's skin has turned pale and bloodless.
LanguageData.DeadWorld_ZombieRotDark.label: rotting
LanguageData.DeadWorld_ZombieRotDark.description: The corpse's skin is darkened by bruising and decay.
